title: Northgate+ Tier Benefits Chart: Fuel, Streaming, Deal Access and Shared Use
content:
The benefits of **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** beyond delivery, tier by tier: the fuel discount, the bundled streaming subscription, early access to Northgate Deal Days, household sharing, Business employee seats and tax-exempt checkout support.

| Tier | Fuel discount at Northgate Fuel (US cents per gallon) | Bundled streaming subscription | Early Deal Days access (hours) | Additional household members | Business employee seats | Supports tax-exempt checkout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Northgate+ Assist | 10 | yes | 3 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Northgate+ Student | 10 | yes | 3 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 10 | yes | 3 | 1 | 0 | no |
| Northgate+ Annual | 10 | yes | 3 | 1 | 0 | no |
| Northgate+ Business | 10 | no | 3 | 0 | 5 | yes |

**What each column means**

- *Fuel discount*: the fuel discount at Northgate Fuel stations, in US cents per gallon.
- *Bundled streaming subscription*: whether the tier includes the bundled streaming subscription.
- *Early Deal Days access*: the hours of early access to Northgate Deal Days events ahead of the general start.
- *Additional household members*: the number of additional household members who may share the delivery benefits.
- *Business employee seats*: the number of employee sign-ins that may share a Business membership's benefits.
- *Tax-exempt checkout*: whether the membership supports tax-exempt checkout once a valid exemption certificate is on file with Northgate Business.

**Comparisons drawn from the chart**

- Northgate+ Business is the only tier with employee seats (up to 5) and tax-exempt checkout support, and it carries no bundled streaming subscription.
- Northgate+ Monthly and Northgate+ Annual each allow 1 additional household member; every other tier allows none.
- Every paid Northgate+ tier carries the 10-cent fuel discount and 3 hours of early deal access; Northgate Rewards carries neither.
